turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Daniel speaking. How may I help you? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've been waiting weeks for an update on my claim. This is unacceptable and I'd like to complain. My policy number is OS-623519.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Elena Petrova.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Ms Petrova, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've been waiting weeks for an update on your claim and you'd like to complain. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There's nothing more I can do, the claims team is just very busy at the moment.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you tell me roughly when you made the claim?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About three weeks ago.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That's not good enough, surely someone can fix this today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, you'll pay an excess, which is the part of any claim you cover yourself, and if someone else was at fault we may recover the costs from their insurer.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Claims are normally acknowledged within 24 hours and assessed within 10 working days once we have all the documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ms Petrova. Our team will be in touch about it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
